name: PristinoBot - Notificaciones de Agroquímicos (Hardware y Manual)

parameters.query:
SELECT 
  n.id AS notif_id,
  n.type,
  n.title,
  n.description,
  n."taskId",
  n."dosingLogId",
  -- Datos de TaskLog (Hardware)
  t.purpose AS hw_purpose,
  t.zones AS hw_zones,
  t."scheduledAt" AS hw_scheduled_at,
  s_hw.name AS hw_schedule_name,
  a_hw.name AS hw_agrochemical_name,
  CASE WHEN a_hw."dosageValue" IS NOT NULL AND a_hw."dosageUnit" IS NOT NULL 
       THEN (a_hw."dosageValue"::text || ' ' || a_hw."dosageUnit"::text) 
       ELSE '' 
  END AS hw_preparation,
  -- Datos de DosingLog (Manual)
  d.purpose AS manual_purpose,
  d.zones AS manual_zones,
  d."scheduledAt" AS manual_scheduled_at,
  s_d.name AS manual_schedule_name,
  a_d.name AS manual_agrochemical_name,
  CASE WHEN a_d."dosageValue" IS NOT NULL AND a_d."dosageUnit" IS NOT NULL 
       THEN (a_d."dosageValue"::text || ' ' || a_d."dosageUnit"::text) 
       ELSE '' 
  END AS manual_preparation
FROM "Notification" n
LEFT JOIN "TaskLog" t ON n."taskId" = t.id
LEFT JOIN "AutomationSchedule" s_hw ON t."scheduleId" = s_hw.id
LEFT JOIN "Agrochemical" a_hw ON t."agrochemicalId" = a_hw.id
LEFT JOIN "DosingLog" d ON n."dosingLogId" = d.id
LEFT JOIN "DosingSchedule" s_d ON d."scheduleId" = s_d.id
LEFT JOIN "Agrochemical" a_d ON d."agrochemicalId" = a_d.id
WHERE n."readAt" IS NULL AND n.status = 'UNREAD'::"NotificationStatus"
ORDER BY n."createdAt" ASC
LIMIT 10;
=UPDATE "Notification" SET "readAt" = NOW(), status = 'READ'::"NotificationStatus" WHERE id = '{{ $('Formatear Mensaje Push HW').item.json.notifId }}';
